summary.zh: AMZN、TSLA 跌破 200 日線，偏多訊號 8 檔以超賣反彈為主
summary.en: AMZN and TSLA broke below the 200-day MA; 8 bullish signals, mostly oversold rebounds

text.zh: COST 下跌 0.45%，RSI 70.2 超買，MACD 偏空、均線多頭排列
text.en: COST fell 0.45%; RSI 70.2 is overbought, MACD bearish, MAs in bullish alignment

text.zh: AMZN 下跌 3.12%、TSLA 下跌 1.18%，MACD 偏空、均線盤整
text.en: AMZN fell 3.12% and TSLA 1.18%; MACD bearish, MAs range-bound

text.zh: LLY 下跌 1.09%，RSI 56.3、MACD 偏空、均線盤整
text.en: LLY fell 1.09%; RSI 56.3, MACD bearish, MAs range-bound

text.zh: XLE 上漲 0.74%，RSI 38.6、MACD 偏空、均線盤整
text.en: XLE rose 0.74%; RSI 38.6, MACD bearish, MAs range-bound

text.zh: AMZN、TSLA 跌破 200 日線，兩檔都是關注股票
text.en: AMZN and TSLA broke below the 200-day MA; both are on the watch list

text.zh: 過去 5 年跌破 200 日線後 20 天平均 1.44%、上漲機率 56.69%，和平常差不多
text.en: Over 5 years, 20 days after a 200-day MA break averaged 1.44% with a 56.69% up rate, similar to normal

text.zh: 超賣反彈出現在 006208.TW、CAT、GOOGL、INTC、PLTR、TSM、VT
text.en: Oversold rebound signals appeared in 006208.TW, CAT, GOOGL, INTC, PLTR, TSM and VT

text.zh: 超賣反彈過去 5 年後 20 天平均 3.16%，高於平常的 1.73%，有參考價值
text.en: Over 5 years, oversold rebounds averaged 3.16% over the next 20 days vs 1.73% normally, a useful signal

text.zh: BND 上漲 0.34% 並突破 200 日線，這條規則過去表現和平常差不多
text.en: BND rose 0.34% and crossed above the 200-day MA; historically this rule performed similar to normal

summary.zh: 中東衝突消息密集，美國第三季 GDP 大幅上修引發爭議
summary.en: Dense Middle East conflict headlines; a large upward revision to US Q3 GDP drew controversy

text.zh: 沙烏地阿美 Jazan 煉油廠遭攻擊，一名員工死亡、部分作業停擺
text.en: An attack on Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery killed a worker and halted some operations

text.zh: 科威特一處設施遇襲造成兩名義大利人死亡，伊朗否認涉入
text.en: Two Italians were killed in an attack on a Kuwait site; Iran denied involvement

text.zh: 美國第三季 GDP 大幅上修，川普要求調查這項「創紀錄的錯誤」
text.en: US Q3 GDP was revised sharply higher; Trump demanded a probe into the 'record setting error'

text.zh: 伊拉克關閉庫德斯坦地區通往敘利亞與伊朗的兩個邊境口岸
text.en: Iraq closed two border crossings in the Kurdistan region with Syria and Iran

text.zh: TSLA：歐盟把自駕表決延到 12 月 15 日，股價下跌 1.18%
text.en: TSLA: the EU delayed its self-driving vote to December 15; shares slipped 1.18%

text.zh: AMZN：黑色星期五前，高盛對 Amazon 發出正面看法的報導
text.en: AMZN: a report says Goldman Sachs sent a strong signal on Amazon ahead of Black Friday

text.zh: LLY：報導指出 Eli Lilly 自 4 月以來上漲 64%，市值約為 Novo Nordisk 的 7 倍
text.en: LLY: reports note Eli Lilly is up 64% since April and is worth about 7 times Novo Nordisk

text.zh: COST：BJ's 跟進 Costco、Sam's Club 感恩節當天休息
text.en: COST: BJ's joined Costco and Sam's Club in closing stores on Thanksgiving Day

text.zh: XLE：能源類股週三下午走高
text.en: XLE: energy stocks advanced on Wednesday afternoon

text.zh: 素材中未來 7 天沒有觀察清單股票的財報
text.en: No watch-list earnings in the next 7 days in the materials
